title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.68
subtitle: AETHER: sewing like Marvelous, OGC, Fit Pose, Wind, Shrink, Inflate and a Grab that slides.

highlights.title: Smooth grabbing
highlights.description: Live starts from the Fit Pose like a Bake, and fast pulls no longer explode or leave stuck vertices.

highlights.title: No frozen vertices
highlights.description: Cloth held in place by its own folds is released and slides or falls instead of hanging in mid-air after a fast pull.

highlights.title: Engines from the server
highlights.description: AETHER and TETHYS now install and update in Preferences > Solver Engine instead of shipping inside the add-on. Click Install once after this update.

highlights.title: Sewing like Marvelous
highlights.description: Seams close fast and in the air, the seam line no longer fights itself, and a closed seam bends like the cloth (fold angle flat).

highlights.title: Wind for AETHER
highlights.description: Force Empties blow the cloth in Live and in bakes: speed, gusts, turbulence and the same air field as the Wind preview.
